description: Compatibility and rhythm rules. Every rule has severity error or warn and named exceptions where real pages violate it. The same rule ids are implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py; verify_all.py checks the id sets are identical and runs every rule over the real route block orders.

rules.description: The chrome nodes (promo bar, nav, footer) must be present exactly when the template chrome says so, and their variants must equal the template chrome (nav opaque, translucent or inverted; footer default or short). A /lp/* page therefore can never carry a nav.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Promo bar first, then nav, and footer last; chrome nodes never appear between content nodes.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Every node (section plus variant) must be listed in the declared template node list; keyed on (section, variant), never on the bare section id.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Every node the declared template marks required must be present.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: In a fixed-order template the nodes must follow the template node order (a fixed-position section cannot be moved).
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: A (section, variant) may not occur more often than its template node allows: one unless repeatable, and never above maxOccurrences. This also enforces one-per-page sections.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Sections whose contract says onePerPage may appear at most once in a page regardless of variant.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: A page has at most one HERO-class section (a section whose contract says semantic.category HERO), for every template. params.heroSections must equal that set (verify_all.py).
rules.evidence: PAGES_SPEC 4.1 and 9: every sampled page has a single hero
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: The first content node of a free-order block page should be a HERO-class section or an opener section.

exceptions.reason: Pages that are only a long-form text block have no hero.

rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Compare pages open with the compare hero and close with the FAQ (before the footer).
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: At most one SectionTextBlock with-toc per page.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: The same (section, variant) should not repeat back to back.

exceptions.reason: These blocks legitimately repeat consecutively on real pages (TextWithImage up to 6 times, three prose blocks, three table blocks, three spacers).

rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: The PageSpec route must exist in templates/routes.json, must not be a redirect, and must be assigned to exactly the declared template.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Sections that declare constraints.routes (bespoke pages) or homeRouteOnly may only be used on those routes.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: No string anywhere in a PageSpec may contain an absolute http or https URL. External destinations render as non-link elements in the clone (src/routing.js href() maps any http(s) URL to the home page as a safety net).
rules.evidence: user constraint: no external-domain links anywhere
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Every link field and every [label](/path) link inside text must resolve to one of the built routes; /careers/<id> job pages are not built and may never be linked. Query states such as /blog?filter=<slug> resolve through their base path.
rules.evidence: PAGES_SPEC 6: job detail pages are not in ROUTES.json and fall to the Pending page
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Links should point at the final route, not at a route that only redirects (for example /solutions/consumer-goods).
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Every text field respects the maxWords budget of its section contract (link labels count the label only).
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: An asset reference must use a role from the field allowedRoles; roles with a pinned generation policy (people, customer logos, brand wordmark, award badges, decorative illustrations, form endpoints) may only appear in fields that allow them.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Section variantRules: required, forbidden and minimum-item content per variant.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Template node contentRules: required and forbidden content fields for a node in that template.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: The node motion (pattern, reducedMotionFallback) must be one of the pairs the section contract lists, with the fallback that matches real behaviour.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: The site has exactly one scroll reveal (PageLinks). Any motion pattern containing "reveal" is only allowed on shared.page-links. There are no other scroll reveals, fade-ups or parallax.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: Chrome sections are site-wide; page-level content for them should be empty.
rules.checkedAgainst: templates/templates.json node lists and the real block orders in templates/routes.json (verify_all.py conformance check)

rules.description: semantic.category is one of SHELL, HERO, PROOF, FEATURES, CONTENT, CONVERSION, FEED, ARTICLE. A section carrying a form endpoint is CONVERSION (or a HERO or SHELL that embeds the form); editorial and news collections are never FEATURES.
rules.checkedAgainst: every section contract in sections/ (verify_all.py classification and sections checks)

rules.description: retrievalEligible is a closed boolean (default true). Layout-only utility and runtime UI (cookie or consent banners, modals, dialogs, overlays) are pinned to false with a reason of 30+ characters; the pinned list is defined independently in semantic_validate.py and verify_all.py.
rules.checkedAgainst: every section contract in sections/ (verify_all.py classification and sections checks)

rules.description: mode generated: no spelling of the source brand (the real company and the clone's stand-in brand: wordmark text, domain, handle, legal name) in any rendered string, route or alt text. Matched on NFKC-normalised text with zero-width characters removed.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no call-to-action label of the source (brand-verb forms such as 'Try <brand>' and the exact verb-led labels its content uses).
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no run of five consecutive normalised words that hashes to a 5-word shingle of the source copy (the clone's placeholder text and any quoted copy in the specs). Hash prefixes only are stored.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no host, endpoint, form or store link, embed, press outlet, customer site or social profile that the source documents link to.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: an absolute URL in text may only use a reserved host (*.example, *.invalid, example.com, example.org, example.net); link fields hold root-relative routes only.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no real customer or partner of the source (names read from its /customers routes). English-word names that cannot be matched safely in text are listed in sourceBrand.ambiguousEnglishWordNames and stay blocked as logos.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no real person named by the source (profile, joins, Q&A and conversation routes). Use fictional names with avatar.fictional-placeholder.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: no review score, star glyph, review-platform name or analyst-firm ranking that the source cites.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: a competitor, third-party service or programme name the source mentions is allowed but flagged for a human check.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: an asset field may not carry a reference-only or blocked-for-generation role (the clone's wordmark, customer-logo stand-ins, product artboards, person photographs). Availability is pinned in code.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: a generation-safe role must also be one of the field's generation-safe roles (its allowed roles that are generation-safe plus their substitutes).

params.derived: generated_field_roles() from the pinned availability and substitutes

rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: the page's nav, footer and promo bar and closing call-to-action bar must carry their own brandName, menus, groups, copyright, offers, title and button so that nothing falls back to the clone's own chrome copy.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: the route is a built route bound to the declared template, or an unbuilt route inside that template's route family (same parent path); single-route templates admit only their own route. Section route restrictions apply to the template's canonical route.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: mode generated: if a required source pattern category (brand, cta, url, customer, person, rating) or the copy shingle set is empty or unusable, validation fails closed instead of passing.
rules.checkedAgainst: adversarial_test.py generated-mode mutations and every generated example in schema/examples (verify_all.py generated_examples check)

rules.description: Always on: every role's availability (reference-only, generation-safe, blocked-for-generation) and generationSafeSubstitutes in assets/asset-roles.json equal the table pinned in semantic_validate.py, which extraction/verify_all.py pins again independently.
rules.checkedAgainst: assets/asset-roles.json and every section contract (verify_all.py asset_roles check)

rules.description: Always on: every section contract's generatedAssetRoles equals the roles derived from its asset fields and the pinned availability.
rules.checkedAgainst: every section contract in sections/ (verify_all.py sections check)
